output.reason: ACC-LADDER-600 is a cable ladder 600 mm wide and 3 m long, matching every stated specification; the customer's 'cable ladders' excludes the cable tray candidates and the other ladder widths.
The 40x40 mm aluminium mounting rail of 3.3 m length matches the stated profile and length, and the rail connector and other sizes are excluded by the customer's specifications.
CAB-H07-5G10 is the H07RN-F 5G10 mm² rubber flexible cable, matching the customer's type code, 5 cores and 10 mm² cross-section; no other candidate shares this specification.
Candidate TRF-DRY-400-20 is a cast-resin dry-type transformer (Gießharztransformator) rated 400 kVA at 20/0.4 kV, matching every specification the customer stated, and it is the only such candidate.
Customer asked for a 40x40 mounting rail of 2.2 m, and PV-RAIL-40X40-2200 is the aluminium 40x40 mm rail at 2.2 m; the 40x60 variant shares the length but differs in cross-section, so it is excluded.

CAB-PV-6-RD is H1Z2Z2-K 1x6 mm² solar cable in red, matching the requested type, cross-section and colour; the other 6 mm² candidate is black and the red 10 mm² and 4 mm² candidates differ in cross-section.
The customer asked for a ground screw of length 1600, and PV-GSCREW-1600 is the ground screw 1600 mm, the only candidate matching both product type and length.
CAB-NYY-4X240 is NYY-J 4x240 mm² copper power cable 0.6/1 kV, matching the requested type, cores, cross-section and conductor material; no other candidate has 4x240 copper.
Candidate PV-BOLT-M10X200 is a hanger bolt M10x200 mm, matching the requested hanger bolt M10x200 in size and unit (pcs); the other candidates differ in length or thread size.
The customer asked for a 40x40 rail of 6.0 m per piece, and PV-RAIL-40X40-6000 is the 40x40 mm aluminium mounting rail at 6 m, the only candidate matching both the profile and length.

The only candidate, PV-TRAP-CLAMP, is a trapezoidal sheet metal roof clamp, and its alias list includes Trapezblechklemme, so it matches the customer's line with no stated specifications that conflict.
ACC-LADDER-600 is a cable ladder, 600 mm wide and 3 m long, matching every stated specification; the tray and other-width ladder candidates do not match.
CAB-H07-5G16 is H07RN-F 5G16 mm², which matches the customer's type code, 5 cores and 16 mm² cross-section exactly; no other candidate has the same cores and cross-section.
The customer asked for an M20 cable gland, and ACC-GLAND-M20 is the only candidate with that thread size; the other glands are M16, M25, M32, M40, M50 and M63, and the clip is not a gland.
CAB-PV-6-BK is the H1Z2Z2-K 1x6 mm² black solar DC cable, matching cable type, core count and cross-section, and colour; the only other 6 mm² option is red, and the connectors are not cables.
The customer asked for a roof hook for slate (Schiefer), and PV-HOOK-SLATE is the roof hook for slate roofs, while the other candidates are for adjustable, plain tile, or pantile roofs.
Only one candidate is a mid clamp for a 35 mm frame in silver, matching every stated specification (the 35 mm end clamp and the black or other-size mid clamps differ).
CAB-NYM-3X1.5 is NYM-J 3x1.5 mm² installation cable, matching the requested type, 3 cores and 1.5 mm² cross-section; the only other 3-core 1.5 mm² candidate is NYY, a different cable type.
Only candidate matching the stated 1600 kVA rating and 20/0.4 kV voltage level for an oil-immersed transformer; the 10/0.4 kV variant differs in voltage.
ACC-MCCB-630 is a 3-pole MCCB rated 630 A, matching the requested type, pole count and current rating; the other candidates are rated 100 to 1600 A and do not match.
PV-MID-30-BLK is a module mid clamp for 30 mm frames in black, which matches the customer's mid clamp, 30 mm frame, and black spec; no other candidate is a mid clamp for 30 mm in black.
Only candidate matching NA2XS(F)2Y, 1x150 mm², and 12/20 kV voltage level; the customer did not state conductor material and no other candidate fits the same size and rating.
CAB-NYY-5X2.5 is NYY-J 5x2.5 mm² copper power cable, matching the requested type, five cores and 2.5 mm² cross-section; no other candidate has five cores at 2.5 mm².
CAB-PV-6-BK is the H1Z2Z2-K 1x6 mm² black solar cable, matching the customer's type, cross-section, and colour; the red and other-size candidates do not fit.
CAB-NYY-5X25 is NYY-J 5x25 mm² copper power cable 0.6/1 kV, matching the customer's 5 cores and 25 mm² cross-section exactly; no other candidate has 5 cores.
ACC-LADDER-400 is a 400 mm wide, 3 m long cable ladder, matching the customer's product type, width and length; the other ladder candidates have different widths.

missing_info: Customer also asks accounting to correct the PO number on invoice 2026-4471 from August, from 88120 onward; this is a separate open point for a person to handle.
